transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We've got eighteen totes of spent solvent from the cleaning process staged in the waste area awaiting disposition. Before I can authorize shipment, we need to go through our routine waste-disposition huddle. Let's start with the compliance report and the logistics report in full, and then I'll complete the disposition decision. Who's ready to begin?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical compliance issue before we proceed. My laboratory review this morning reclassified the spent solvent as UN1993 flammable liquid, packing group II — it is no longer classified as routine recyclable solvent. This means the 18 totes must be transferred into 18 UN-rated steel drums before shipment, and a hazardous-waste manifest is required. I have not yet entered the reclassification into the formal waste register because I'm waiting on the plant manager's disposition signature.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Here's the logistics report. I've confirmed with our licensed hazardous-waste carrier that it will accept these 18 drums, but only for a Friday 16:00 pickup, and only if they are arranged on exactly 3 pallets and the manifest is submitted by 12:00 Friday. I have not yet booked the pickup because the waste classification was awaiting confirmation — which Jonas has now provided.
transcript.speaker: A3

decisions.disposition_route: licensed hazardous-waste carrier for disposal as UN1993 flammable liquid, packing group II

commitments.detail: Enter the UN1993 flammable liquid, packing group II reclassification into the formal waste register upon this authorization signature.
Book the Friday 16:00 pickup with the licensed hazardous-waste carrier, arrange the 18 drums on exactly 3 pallets, and submit the hazardous-waste manifest by Friday 12:00.
Transfer the 18 totes of spent solvent into 18 UN-rated steel drums before the Friday pickup.
